verdict.rationale: Publishing a robots.txt is a fair question for any public web service, including CIPO's online IP databases and filing portals, so the axis applies. Nothing in the evidence pack mentions a robots.txt file or any crawler-access policy. The cited pages cover trademark, patent and bulk-data services, not crawl permissions, so there is nothing to credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native founder, the service publishes a real robots.txt, so an agent can know what it may read before fetching anything
